description: Source code for the Festligare recipe scraper class, inheriting from AbstractScraper, with methods to extract recipe details such as category, keywords, yields, ingredients, instructions, ratings, and ratings count.

classes.name: Festligare
classes.description: A scraper class for recipes from festligare.se, extending AbstractScraper and implementing methods to parse recipe data.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website, 'festligare.se'.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Extracts the recipe category from schema.org data or breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: keywords
methods.description: Extracts recipe keywords from schema.org data or HTML content.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts the number of yields from schema.org data or HTML content.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts list of ingredients from schema.org data or HTML content.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients using utility function, based on HTML structure.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts cooking instructions from schema.org data or HTML content.

methods.name: ratings
methods.description: Retrieves recipe ratings, either from schema.org data or HTML.

methods.name: ratings_count
methods.description: Retrieves the number of ratings/reviews from schema.org data or HTML.
